paite: Lampi a mihoihkimte'n nuam asa uhi, TOUPA dan zuite'n.
heading: Aleph / TOUPA Dan
english: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.

paite: Athu theihsakte zuite'n nuam asa uhi, lungtang tengteng a amah zongte'n.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

paite: Ahi, amau diktatlouhna ahih kei ua; alampite ah apai zel uhi.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

paite: Nang na thuzohna thute phatuamngaitak a, zui ding in thu na hon pia hi.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

paite: Aw, na dan thusehte zui ding in ka omdante hihkip in omleh aw;
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

paite: Huai hun chiang in ka zahlak kei ding a, na thupiakte khawk ka sak hun chiang in.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

paite: Lungtang diktak pu in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding hi. Na vaihawmna dikte ka zil hun chiang in.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

paite: Na dan thuseh ka zui ding a, aw, hon paisan den ke'n.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

paite: Valnou in, bangchi in ahia a- omdan ahihsiangthou ding? Na thu bang zel a a-omdan venghoih in.
heading: Beth / TOUPA Dan Zuihna
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

paite: Ka lungtang tengteng in ka hon zong a; Aw, na thupiakte ka paisan zaw phal mahmah ke'n.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

paite: Na tung a thil ka hihkhelh louhna ding in na thu tuh ka lungtang ah ka kem hi.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang nuam na sa hi; na dan thusehte hon zilsak in.
english: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na kam a na vaihawm pawt tengteng ka muk in ka theisakta hi.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

paite: Na thu theihsak lam ah nuam ka sa a, hauhsaknate teng a nuam ka sak bang in.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

paite: Na thuzohna thute ka ngaihtuah ding a, na lampite ka limsak behlap ding hi.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

paite: Na dan thuseh tungte ah ka kipak ding a; na thu ka mangngilh kei ding hi.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

paite: Ka hintheihna ding in na sikha tung ah hoihtak in hih in; huchi in na thu ka zui ding hi.
heading: Gimel / TOUPA Dan A Kipahna
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

paite: Na dan thu a kipan thillamdang ka muhtheihna ding in, ka mitte vaksak in.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

paite: Lei ah mikhual ka hi a; na thupiakte ka lak ah iim ke'n.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

paite: Ka hinna kitamgawp in a-om a, chik lai peuh a na vaihawmna angai hi.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

paite: Mikisathei, hamsiat a omte na taihilh a, na thupiakte vakmangsante.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

paite: Gensiatna leh muhsitna ka kiang a kipan lamang in; na thu theihsakte ka zui hi.
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

paite: Miliante leng atu ua, hon kalh ua; himahleh na sikha in na dan thusehte angaihtuah zaw ahi.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

paite: Na thu theihsakte ka kipahna ahi a, thupha hon hilhte ahi uh.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

paite: Ka hinna leivui ah abelh bikbek a; na thu bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
heading: Daleth / TOUPA Dan Zuih Tup Tintenna
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

paite: Ka omdante ka hon theisak a, nang na hon dawng a; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na thuzohna lam hon theisiamsak in, huchi in na thillamdang hih thute ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

paite: Ka hinna lungkham ziak in atuimang nak a; na thu bang zel in hon hihhat in.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

paite: Omdan diklou ka kiang a kipan lasuan inla; hehpih in na dan hon pia in.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

paite: Omdan muanhuai ka tel a; na vaihawmnate ka ma ah ka omsak hi.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

paite: Na thu theihsakte ah ka bel tinten a; TOUPA aw, hon zahlaksak ke'n.
english: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.

paite: Na thupiak lam ah ka tai ding a, ka lungtang na hihlet hun chiang in.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

paite: TOUPA aw, na dan thuseh lampi hon ensak in; huchi in atawp pha in ka tawn ding hi.
heading: He / Theihsiamna Dia Thumna
english: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

paite: Theihsiamna hon pia in, huchi in na dan ka kemhoih ding hi, ahi ka lungtang tengteng in ka zui ding hi.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

paite: Na thupiak lampi ah hon paisak in, huai ah ka kipak ngal a.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

paite: Na thu theihsak lam ah ka lungtang kiheisak in, huaihamna lam ah hilou in.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

paite: Thil bangmah lou phet en lou ding in ka mit kaihei inla, na lampite ah hon hihhalh in.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

paite: Na thu na sikha kiang ah hihkip in, huai nangmah launa ahi.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

paite: Kei a dia gensiatna ka kihtak lamang in; na vaihawmte lah ahoih ngal a.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

paite: Ngai in, na thuzohna thute theih ka ut gige a; na diktatna ziak in hon hihhalh in.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihnate ka kiang ah hong pai hen, na hotdamna ngei, na thu bang zel in.
heading: Vau / TOUPA Dan Muanna
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

paite: Huchi in hon gensete dawnna ding ka nei ding a, na thu lah ka muang ngal a.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

paite: Huan thutak thu ka kam a kipan lakhe vek ke'nla; na vaihawmnate ka lamen gige ngal a.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

paite: Huchi in na dan ka zui gige ding a, tangtawn tangtawn in.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

paite: Huan noplenna ah ka vak ding a; na thuzohna thute ka zong hi.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

paite: Na thu theihsak thute kumpipate ma ah ka gen ding a, ka zum kei ding hi.
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

paite: Huan ka it, na thupiak ah ka kipak ding hi.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

paite: Na thupiak, ka it lamte ah, ka khutte ka zak ding a, na dan thusehte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

paite: Na sikha kiang a thuchiam theigige in, Nang na hon lametsak ziak in.
heading: Zain / TOUPA Dan A Kingakna
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

paite: Huai ka gimthuakna ah leng ka khamuanna ahi, na thu in lah ahon hihhalhta ngal a.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

paite: Kisatheite'n nakpitak in hon nuihsan ua, himahleh na dan ka pai hoisan kei hi.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

paite: TOUPA aw, nidanglai a na vaihawmte ka theigige a, ka kikhamuan zel hi.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

paite: Lung hihlouhna in nakpitak in hon buakkhumta a, migilou-salou na dan paisante ziak in.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

paite: Ka khualzinna inn ah na dan thusehte ka la ahi gige hi.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

paite: TOUPA aw, zan chiang in na min ka theigige hi, na dan leng ka zui gige hi.
english: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

paite: Huai ka nei a, na thuzohna thute ka vomhoih ziak in.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

paite: TOUPA ka tantuan ahi a; na thu ka zui ding chih ka gen khinta hi.
heading: Kheth / TOUPA Dan A Kipumpiakna
english: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

paite: Ka lungtang tengteng in na deihsakna ka ngen a; na thu bang zel in hon hehpih in.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

paite: Ka omdante ka ngaihtuah a, na thu theihsak lam ah ka kalsuan hi.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

paite: Ka kintat a, na thupiakte zui ding in ka zekai kei hi;
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

paite: Migilou-salou khauhual in hon gaklom gige a; himahleh na dan ka mangngilh kei hi.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

paite: Zankim in kipahthu gen ding in ka thou ding a, na vaihawm diktatte ziak in.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

paite: Nangmah laute leh na thuzohna thu zuite lawm ka hi.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

paite: TOUPA aw, leitung na zahngaihna in adim ahi; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes. TETH

paite: TOUPA aw, na thu bang in na sikha na hihhoih zel hi.
heading: Teth / TOUPA Dan Manphatna
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.

paite: Ngaihtuah siamna leh theihna hon sinsak in; na thupiakte ka gingta hi.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

paite: Hihhaksat a ka om ma in ka vakmang a, tu'n zaw na thu ka zuita hi.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

paite: Nang na hoih a, thil hoih leng na hih a; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Kisatheite'n ka tung ah zuau a phuaktawm ua, ka lungtang tengteng in na thuzohna thute ka vomhoih ding hi.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

paite: Alungtang uh sungthau bang in athau a; Kei bel na dan tung ah ka kipak gige hi.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

paite: Na dan thusehte ka ziltheihna ding a hihhaksat a ka om ahoih hi.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

paite: Dangka-eng leh dangka sang tampi sang in na kam a dan pawt kei a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

paite: Na khut in hon siam in, ahon sek hi; na thupiakte ka sintheihna ding in theihsiamna hon pia in.
heading: Jod / TOUPA Dan Vaihawmna Dik
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

paite: Nangmah laute'n ahon mu ding ua, akipak ding uh; na thu ka lamet ziak in.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

paite: TOUPA aw, na vaihawmte adik chih leh nang ginomtak in ahi, na hon hihgim chih ka thei hi.
english: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

paite: Na sikha kiang a na thuchiam bang zel in hehpih in na zahngaihna ka khamuanna hisak in.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

paite: Ka hintheihna ding in na zahngaihnate ka kiang ah hong pai hen; na dan ka kipahna ahi.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

paite: Kisathei zahlak in om uhen; dikloupi in hon hihniamta ua; himahleh na thuzohna thute ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

paite: Nang hon laute'n kei lam hong nga uhen, na thu theihsakte athei ding uhi.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

paite: Ka zahlaklouhna ding in ka lungtang na dan thusehte ah hoihkim in om hen.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

paite: Ka hinna na hotdamna ngai in abah a; himahleh na thu ka lamen gige hi.
heading: Kaph / Hotkhiakna Dia Thumna
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

paite: Na thu etna in ka mit avai khinta a, "Nang chikchiang a hon khamuan ding na hia?" ka chi, ka chi a.
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

paite: Meikhu uk savun thawl bang ka na hita ngal a; himahleh na dan thusehte ka mangngilh kei hi.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

paite: Na sikha kum chiang ding bang tan hi ding ahia, hon simmohte tung ah chikchiang in ahia vai na hawm ding?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

paite: Mikisathei, na dan bang a omloute'n ka kiakna ding in kokhukte atou uhi.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

paite: Na thupiak tengteng a ginom ahi; amau dikloupi in hon simmoh uh; hon panpih in!
english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

paite: Amau lei ah hon hihmang dekdek ua; himahleh na thuzohna thute lah ka kiheisan ngal kei hi.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

paite: Na zahngaihna bang zel in hon hihhalh in; huchi in na kam a thu theihsak ka zui ding hi.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

paite: TOUPA aw, tangtawn a ding in na thu van ah kiptak in a-om hi.
heading: Lamed / TOUPA Dan A Ginna
english: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

paite: Na ginomna suan tengteng pha in a-om ding hi; leitung na hihkip a, a-om gige hi.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

paite: Huaite tuni in na vaihawmte bang in a-om gige a thil teng na sikhate ahi uhi.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

paite: Na dan ka kipahna hi keileh zaw, ka gimthuakna a mangthang ding hi ing a.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

paite: Na thuzohna thute chik lai peuh in leng ka mangngilh kei ding, nang lah huaite in na hon hihhalhta ngal a.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

paite: Nang a ka hi, hon hondam in; na thuzohna thute ka zong ngal a.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

paite: Migilou-saloute'n hihmang tum in ahon ngak ua; himahleh na thu theihsakte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

paite: Hoihkimna teng tawpna ka mu a; na thupiak aza ngei e.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

paite: Aw, na dan deih hi na tel ing e! Nitum a ka ngaihtuah ahi.
heading: Mem / TOUPA Dan Ngaihnatna
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

paite: Na thupiakte'n hon doute sang a pilzaw in hon bawl a; tangtawn a ka kiang a a-om gige ziak in.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

paite: Hon hilhte tengteng sang in pilna ka nei zaw ahi; na thu theihsakte ka ngaihtuah ahih nak ziak in.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

paite: Tekte sang in ka theisiam zaw a, ahi, na thuzohna thute ka vomhoih ziak in.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

paite: Na thu ka zuihtheihna ding in lampi gilou himhim ah ka khete kalsuan ka phal kei hi.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

paite: Na vaihawmna a pan ka pial kei; nang na hon hilh ziak in.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

paite: Na thute ka kam a ding in khum hi na tel e! Ahi, ka kam a ding in khuaizu sang in akhumzaw hi.
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

paite: Na thuzohna thute ziak in theihsiamna ka nei zel; huaiziak in omdan diklou peuhmah ka hua hi.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

paite: Na thu ka khe a ding in khawnvak ahi a, ka lampi a ding in vak ahi.
heading: Nun / TOUPA Dan A Kipan A Vakna
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

paite: Na vaihawmna diktatte zui ding in ka kichiam a, ka hihkip lai hi.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

paite: Nakpitak a hihhaksat in ka om a; TOUPA aw, na thu bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

paite: TOUPA aw, hehpih in ka kam a ka deih thu phatna ana sang inla, na dante hon sinsak in.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

paite: Ka hinna ka khut ah a-om a; himahleh, na dan ka mangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

paite: Migilou-saloute'n ka awkna ding in thang akam ua; himahleh na thuzohna thute ka vakmangsan kei hi.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

paite: Na thu theihsakte tangtawn a gouluah ding in ka la a; ka lungtang hihnuam pen ahi.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

paite: Na dan thusehte, atawp pha a zui ding in, ka lungtang ka koihkipta hi.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

paite: Bangmah lou ngaihtuahnate ka hua a, na dan ka deih ahi.
heading: Samekh / TOUPA Dan A Bitna
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

paite: Nang ka bukna mun leh ka phaw na hi a; na thu ka lamet ahi.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

paite: Nou thil hoih lou hihte aw, hon paisan un; ka Pathian thilpiakte ka vomhoih theihna ding in.
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

paite: Ka hintheihna ding in na thu bang zel in hon len nilouh inla, ka lamet tung ah zahlak in hon omsak ke'n.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

paite: Hon kai in, huchi in ka bit ding a, na dan thusehte ka khawk sa gige ding ahi.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

paite: Na dan thusehte vakmangsan tengteng na musit a; akhemna uh lah zuau ahi.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

paite: Lei a migilou-salou tengteng eksia bang in na hihmang a, huaiziak in na thu theihsakte ka deih hi.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

paite: Ka sa nangmah lau in aling a, na vaihawmnate leng ka lau hi.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

paite: Vai ka hawm a, diktattak in ka hih hi; hon nuaisiahte lak ah hon nuse ke'n.
heading: Ayin / TOUPA Dan A Thumanna
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

paite: Na sikha tungtang thu ah, ahoihna a bultum in; kisatheite'n hon nuaisiah kei uhen.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

paite: Na hotdamna etna in ka mit avai khinta a, na thu diktattak etna toh in.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

paite: Na zahngaihna bang zel in na sikha tung ah hih inla, na dan thusehte hon hilh in.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na sikha ka hi a, theihsiamna hon pia in; na thu theihsakte ka theihna ding in.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

paite: TOUPA, sep ahunta; na dan bangmah lou in abawlta uhi.
english: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

paite: Huaiziak in na thupiakte dangka-eng sang in ka deih a; ahi, dangka-eng siangthou sang in.
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

paite: Huaiziak in thil peuhmah thu a na thuzohna thu tengteng dik in ka thei a; omdan diklou peuhmah ka hua ahi.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

paite: Na thu theihsakte alamdang a; huaiziak in ka hinna in azui hi.
heading: Pe / TOUPA Dan Zuih Lunggulhna
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

paite: Na thu hilhchet in mite ahihvak a; mimawlte atheisiamsak hi.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

paite: Kam zapi in ka ka a, ka nak hawphawp hi; na thupiakte ka lunggulh ziak in.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

paite: Kei lam hong nga inla, hon hehpih in, na min deihte na hehpih bang in.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

paite: Ka khe kalsuante na thu ah hihkip inla; gitlouhnate ka tung ah thu neisak ke'n.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

paite: Mihing nuaisiahna pan hon humbit in; huchi in na thuzohna thute ka zui ding hi.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

paite: Na mel in na sikha sunvak inla; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na dan azuih louh ziak in, Lui a tui bang in ka mit ah ka khitui aluangkhia hi.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

paite: TOUPA aw, nang na dik a, na vaihawmte adik ahi.
heading: Tsadhe / TOUPA Dan Dikna
english: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

paite: Na thu theihsakte diktat leh ginom mahmah in thu na pia hi.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

paite: Ka phattuamngaihna in hon negaita, hon doute'n na thu amangngilh ziak un.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

paite: Na thu siangthou mahmah ahi; huaiziak in na sikha in adeih hi.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

paite: Mineu leh mi muhsit ka hi a, himahleh na thuzohna thute ka mangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

paite: Na diktatna tangtawn diktatna ding ahi a, na dan leng thutak ahi.
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

paite: Mangbatna leh lunglauna in hon buakkhumta a; himahleh na thupiakte ka kipahna ahi.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

paite: Na thu theihsakte tangtawn a ding in adik ahi; theihsiamna hon pia in, huchi in ka hing gige ding hi.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

paite: Ka lungtang tengteng in ka hon sam a; TOUPA aw, hon dawng in; na dan thusehte ka kemhoih ding hi.
heading: Koph / Hotkhiakna Dia Thumna
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

paite: Ka hon sam hi; hon dawng in, huchi in na thu theihsakte ka zui ding hi.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

paite: Phalvak ma in ka thou a, huhna deih in ka kikou a; na thute ka lamen hi.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

paite: Na thu ka ngaihtuah theihna ding in zanvente ma in, ka mitte ahak uhi.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

paite: Na zahngaihna bang zel in ka aw ngaikhia inla; TOUPA aw, na vaihawmnate bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

paite: Ngaihtuah gilou delhte'n ahon naih ua; amau zaw na dan gamlat a om ahi uh.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang zaw na nai a; na thupiak tengteng thutak ahi.
english: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

paite: Nidanglai in, na thu theihsakte a kipan in, huaite tangtawn a ding in na hihkip chih ka na theita hi.
english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

paite: Ka haksatna ngaihtuah inla, hon humbit in; na dan lah ka mangngilh ngei ngal kei a;
heading: Resh / Panpih Ngetna
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

paite: Ka thu hon genpih inla, hon tan in na thu bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

paite: Hotdamna migilou-saloute a pan agamla hi, na dan thusehte azuih louh ziak un.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihnate athupi hi; na vaihawmnate bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

paite: Hon simmohte leh hon doute tampi ahi ua, himahleh na thu theihsakte ka paikawisan kei hi.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

paite: Lepchiahtak a hihte ka en a, ka lungkim kei hi; na thu azuih louh ziak un.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

paite: Na thuzohna thute ka deihdan ngaihtuah inla, TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna bang in hon hihhalh in.
english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

paite: Na thu atung a pan in adik a, na vaihawmna diktat chiteng tangtawn in a-om nilouh hi.
english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

paite: Miliante'n aziak om lou in hon simmoh ua; himahleh ka lungtang in na thute ahi, akihtak.
heading: Shin / TOUPA Dan A Kipiakna
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

paite: Na thu ah nuam ka sa a, thil thupipi gallak amu bang in.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

paite: Zuauthu ka hua in ka kih a; na dan bel ka deih ahi.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

paite: Ni khat in sagihvei nang ka hon phat a, na vaihawm diktatte ziak in.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

paite: Na dan deihte'n khamuanna thupitak anei ua; pukna himhim anei kei uhi.
english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

paite: TOUPA aw, na hotdamna ka lamen a, na thupiakte bang in ka hih zel hi.
english: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

paite: Ka hinna in na thu theihsakte azui gige a; ka deih mahmah hi.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

paite: Na thuzohna thute leh na thu theihsakte ka zui zel a; ka omdan tengteng na ma ah a-om hi.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

paite: TOUPA aw, ka hon sap husa na ma ah hong nai hen; na thu bangbang in theihsiamna hon pia in.
heading: Taw / Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

paite: Hehpih ka ngetna na ma ah tung hen; na thu bang in hon humbit in.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

paite: Na dan thusehte na hon sinsak chiang in, ka muk in nang phatna thu gen hen.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

paite: Ka lei in na thu agen ding a, na thupiak tengteng diktatna ahih ziak in.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

paite: Na khut in hon panpih in, na thuzohna thute ka tel ngal a.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

paite: TOUPA aw, na hotdamna ka lunggulh nak a; na dan ka kipahna ahi.
english: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

paite: Ka hinna hing hen, huchi in ahon phat ding hi; na vaihawmnate'n leng hon panpih hen.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

paite: Belam mang bang in ka vakmang a, na sikha zong in; na thupiakte lah ka mangngilh ngei ngal kei a.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
